description: Submits a new post to a subreddit as the connected account: a text post (kind self) or a link post (kind link). A public action on Reddit under the customer's name, marked as a write so a client can ask before it runs; a subreddit's rules decide whether the post stays up. Billed at the write rate.

flair_id.description: Post flair template id, for subreddits that require flair.

flair_text.description: Post flair text, when the flair template allows editing it.

kind.description: self = text post, link = URL post.

spoiler.description: Mark the post as a spoiler.

name: reddit_submit
title: Submit Post
